upstream.description: Assign issues to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and 17 more coding agents like teammates — open-source and self-hostable.

classification.analysis: Multica is a self-hostable, Kanban-style workspace where AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and 17 more CLIs) are added as teammates, assigned issues, and picked up automatically on a daemon-controlled runtime, reporting progress, raising blockers, and handing work back for human review as a PR. It has a Next.js web frontend, Go/Chi backend with PostgreSQL+pgvector, Electron desktop apps for macOS/Windows/Linux, an Expo iOS app, and integrations with GitHub/GitLab/Gitea, Slack/Lark/DingTalk/WeCom, plus 'squads' mixing agents and people and 'autopilots' for cron-scheduled agent runs. Aimed at teams or solo builders who want to run many different coding-agent CLIs against real issues with an execution log, review gates, and cost tracking.

use_cases.title: Assign a GitHub issue to Claude Code or Codex as if it were a teammate
Self-host a board that drives 20 different coding-agent CLIs
Track token cost and execution logs per agent run
Run scheduled agent standups or audits via autopilots
